name: Fake recruiter asks for a registration fee
hook: A 'recruiter' offers a job or selection and then asks you to pay a registration, joining or documentation fee, often called refundable. Real employers do not charge candidates.
safe_response: Search the company's official careers page
Look up the organisation's contact details yourself (official site or app) and ask them directly
Report the number or profile on the job platform

name: Internship that sells a training kit or certificate
hook: You are 'selected' for an internship at a famous company but must pay for a kit, certificate, or seat confirmation. The company never receives the money.
safe_response: Never pay to get an internship
Check the company's official internship page

name: Like, rate and earn task scam
hook: You get small paid tasks (like videos, rate products). Early payouts are real, then you are asked to deposit larger amounts to unlock 'premium tasks' and never get them back.
safe_response: Report the Telegram group and the payment account

name: Work-from-home data entry for an advance
hook: A data-entry or typing job promises high daily pay but asks for software, security or training charges first.
safe_response: Do not pay for a job
Check for a registered company and address
Search the offer text with the word scam

name: Unsolicited Telegram or WhatsApp job offer
hook: A stranger messages about a part-time job with daily pay, then moves you to a group with tasks and deposits.

name: Overpayment or fake payment confirmation
hook: A buyer 'pays' more than the price or sends a fake payment screenshot and asks you to refund the difference or ship first.
safe_response: Check your own bank balance, not a screenshot
Never refund before money is in your account

name: UPI collect request disguised as a refund or advance
hook: You are told to approve a request or scan a QR to receive money. Receiving money never needs a PIN, approving a collect request sends money out.
safe_response: Never enter a UPI PIN to receive money
Report the request in your UPI app

name: Fake KYC or account-blocked message
hook: A message says your bank, wallet or SIM KYC has expired and gives a link or number to update it, which harvests your details and OTP.
red_flags: asks for OTP, PAN or card
safe_response: Open your bank's own app or site
Call the number on your card

name: Electricity or utility disconnection threat
hook: A message claims your power or gas will be cut tonight unless you call a number or install an app to pay.
red_flags: pending bill you do not recognise
safe_response: Check the bill on the provider's official site or app
Visit the local office if unsure

name: Parcel held at customs or courier fee
hook: A courier or customs 'officer' says a parcel is stuck and you must pay a clearance or redelivery fee through a link.
safe_response: Track the parcel on the courier's real site
Do not pay through message links
Contact the courier through its official number

name: 'Digital arrest' by fake police or customs
hook: Callers pose as police, customs or CBI, claim you are linked to a crime, keep you on a video call, and demand money to 'clear' your name. No agency arrests people over video call.
red_flags: you must stay on the call
safe_response: No real agency demands money on a call
Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in in India

name: Fake bank fraud-department call
hook: Someone claims to be from your bank's fraud team, says there was suspicious activity, and asks you to move money to a 'safe account' or share an OTP.
safe_response: Hang up and call the number on your card
Banks never ask for PIN or OTP
Never transfer money to a 'safe account'

name: Tech support or refund scam needing remote access
hook: A pop-up or caller says your device or account has a problem and asks you to install a remote-control app to fix it or issue a refund.
red_flags: asks to install AnyDesk or similar
caller you did not ask for
safe_response: Do not install remote apps for strangers
If you did, disconnect internet and call your bank

name: Guaranteed returns investment
hook: A scheme promises fixed high returns, often daily or weekly, with 'limited slots'. Early withdrawals work, then the platform disappears.
safe_response: Check registration with the market regulator
Do not invest on a stranger's advice

name: Relationship-then-invest scam
hook: A friendly stranger builds trust over weeks and then introduces a 'sure' crypto or trading platform.
safe_response: Do not move money because of someone you only met online

name: Romance scam asking for money
hook: An online partner invents emergencies, travel costs or customs fees and asks for transfers.
red_flags: asks for gift cards or transfers
safe_response: Ask for a live video call

name: Voice-clone family emergency
hook: A call or voice note sounds like a relative in trouble and asks for urgent money. Scammers can clone a voice from a short clip.
safe_response: Hang up and call the person on their known number
Ask a question only they could answer

name: 'Hi Mum, this is my new number' texts
hook: A text claims to be your child or relative with a new number and soon asks for urgent help paying a bill.
safe_response: Call your relative on the old number

name: Boss or CEO gift-card or transfer request
hook: A message from a 'boss' or senior person asks you to urgently buy gift cards or pay an invoice and keep it quiet.

name: Lottery or prize that needs a fee
hook: You have 'won' something you never entered and must pay tax or a processing fee to claim it.
red_flags: you won a draw you did not enter
safe_response: Real prizes do not need fees

name: Fake scholarship or government grant fee
hook: A message promises a scholarship, subsidy or free laptop under a government scheme if you pay a small processing fee.
safe_response: Never pay to receive a benefit

name: Predatory instant-loan app
hook: An app gives a quick small loan, takes contacts and photos, then harasses you and your contacts with threats and edited pictures.
red_flags: asks for contacts and gallery access
safe_response: Report harassment to the cyber cell

name: Marketplace buyer sends a fake payment screenshot
hook: A buyer shows an edited payment screenshot, then urges you to hand over the item before the money arrives.
safe_response: Confirm the credit in your own banking app
Do not ship before funds clear
Meet in a safe public place

name: Seller demands advance, token or delivery fee
hook: A listing is very cheap, and the seller asks for an advance, token or delivery charge before you can see the item.
safe_response: Prefer cash on delivery or in-person

name: 'Army officer on transfer' selling cheap
hook: A seller claims to be a transferred soldier selling a vehicle or furniture cheaply and uses the uniform to build trust, then asks for an advance.

name: Rental or flat deposit scam
hook: A flat is listed far below market rent and the 'owner' asks for a booking deposit before a viewing, often claiming to be abroad.
safe_response: Do not pay before a signed agreement

name: Fake customer-care number in search results
hook: A search result or social post shows a helpline number that belongs to scammers who then ask for OTPs or remote access.
red_flags: number from search snippet or social post
safe_response: Use contact details from the company's own app or website
If you did, call your bank at once

name: Phishing login page
hook: A link leads to a page that looks like a known login but is on another domain and steals your credentials.

name: Lookalike shopping site
hook: A shop with deep discounts and a name close to a famous brand takes payment and ships nothing.
safe_response: Pay by cash on delivery or card with protection

name: Reused or AI-generated listing photos
hook: A listing uses stock or AI-generated pictures and a perfect description to look real.
red_flags: no photos with a date or tag
safe_response: Ask for a live video of the item

name: Deepfake video-call impersonation
hook: A video call shows a familiar face asking for money or action, but it is a deepfake or replayed video.
safe_response: Ask them to do something unscripted

name: SIM swap or 'upgrade your SIM' OTP
hook: Callers say your SIM must be upgraded (such as to 5G) and ask for a code, which actually transfers your number to them.
safe_response: Never share SIM or OTP codes
Contact your operator through its app
If service drops suddenly, call the operator

name: Friend's hacked account sends a link
hook: A hacked friend's account sends 'vote for me' or 'is this you?' links that steal your login, then spreads further.
safe_response: Ask the friend by another channel

name: Fake charity or disaster appeal
hook: A moving appeal collects donations through a personal account after a disaster.

name: Tax refund phishing
hook: A message says you have a tax refund pending and sends you to a form that collects bank and card details.
safe_response: Check refund status on the official tax portal
The tax department does not ask for card details by message

name: Fake subscription renewal invoice
hook: An invoice for a service you never bought lists a phone number to cancel, which leads to a remote-access or refund scam.

name: 'Wrong number' friendly intro
hook: A stranger texts 'wrong number' and then builds a conversation that leads to investments or money requests.

name: Recovery scam for lost money
hook: After a scam, someone offers to recover your money for a fee, which is a second scam.
safe_response: Report to the police and your bank

name: Fake AI trading bot
hook: A 'proprietary AI bot' promises automated profits and shows a fake dashboard. Deposits vanish.

name: AI-written personalised phishing
hook: A well-written email uses your name, job and recent activity to ask for a login, payment or file open.
safe_response: Verify with the sender by another channel

name: Fake AI customer-support chatbot
hook: A chat widget or social account pretending to be official support asks you to 'verify' with OTP or card details.
safe_response: Use only the company's official app or site
Never give OTPs to chat support

name: Insurance or policy maturity bonus call
hook: Callers say your old policy has a bonus that needs a tax or processing payment.
safe_response: Do not pay to receive a payout

name: Overseas job or visa offer for a fee
hook: An agent promises a visa or foreign job for an upfront fee, then disappears or abandons you abroad.
safe_response: Check the agent against the government's registered list
